test_ExecuteProposal_TransferReturnsFals.notice: spentToday must be decremented back to its pre-execute value when transfer returns false (i.e., the cap is not permanently consumed).
ProposalFailed must be emitted (not ProposalExecuted) when transfer returns false.
After executeProposal when transfer returns false, state must be Failed.
Vault USDC balance must remain unchanged when the transfer returns false (the tokens were never actually moved).

test_ExecuteProposal_TransferReverts_Dec.notice: spentToday must be decremented back when the inner transfer reverts.

test_ExecuteProposal_TransferReverts_Set.notice: After executeProposal when transfer reverts, state must be Failed.

test_ExecuteProposal_TransferReverts_Vau.notice: Vault balance must be unchanged when the inner transfer reverts.

test_ReleaseEscrow_TransferReturnsFalse_.notice: Owner can retry releaseEscrow after the first failed attempt (state is still Active).
EscrowReleaseFailed must be emitted (not EscrowReleased) when transfer returns false.
Payee's USDC balance must not increase when the transfer returns false.
escrowedBalance must be restored (re-incremented) when the transfer returns false.
When usdc.transfer returns false for the payee, the escrow state must remain Active.

test_ReleaseEscrow_TransferReverts_CanRe.notice: Owner can retry releaseEscrow after a reverting attempt (state is still Active).

test_ReleaseEscrow_TransferReverts_Payee.notice: Payee's USDC balance must not increase when the inner transfer reverts.

test_ReleaseEscrow_TransferReverts_Resto.notice: escrowedBalance must be restored when the inner transfer reverts.

test_ReleaseEscrow_TransferReverts_Stays.notice: When usdc.transfer reverts for the payee, the escrow state must remain Active.

test_RetryProposal_HappyPath_EmitsPropos.notice: ProposalExecuted must be emitted with the new recipient.

test_RetryProposal_HappyPath_SetsExecute.notice: After a successful retry the proposal state must be Executed.

test_RetryProposal_HappyPath_TransfersUs.notice: USDC must actually land in the new recipient's wallet.

test_RetryProposal_HappyPath_UpdatesReci.notice: The new recipient stored on the proposal must be updated.

test_RetryProposal_HappyPath_UpdatesSpen.notice: spentToday must be incremented by the proposal amount after a successful retry.

test_RetryProposal_NewRecipientBlocked_D.notice: spentToday decremented again after the second failure.

test_RetryProposal_NewRecipientBlocked_E.notice: ProposalFailed emitted with the new recipient address.

test_RetryProposal_NewRecipientBlocked_R.notice: When the new recipient is also transfer-blocked, the retry should NOT revert but the proposal should end up Failed again.

test_RetryProposal_NewRecipientReverts_E.notice: ProposalFailed emitted (catch branch) in a re-failing retry.

test_RetryProposal_NewRecipientReverts_S.notice: Same scenario but via a reverting transfer.

test_RetryProposal_RevertsForNonOwner().notice: Only the owner may call retryProposal.

test_RetryProposal_RevertsWhenApproved().notice: Retry on an Approved proposal → InvalidProposalState.

test_RetryProposal_RevertsWhenExecuted().notice: Retry on a successfully Executed proposal → InvalidProposalState.

test_RetryProposal_RevertsWhenPending().notice: Retry on a Pending proposal → InvalidProposalState.

test_RetryProposal_RevertsWhenRejected().notice: Retry on a Rejected proposal → InvalidProposalState.
